Cowork Snapshot Exporter

Package a Cowork project into a shareable ZIP.

What it does

Packages a Cowork project into a single timestamped ZIP you can hand to a teammate for training or parallel use. It resolves every context file the project references and preserves folder structure, so the recipient knows exactly where each piece goes.

What's in the ZIP

  • The project's system prompt (instructions).
  • A step-by-step technical setup guide.
  • A non-technical SETUP-GUIDE.md written for first-time Cowork users (workspace folder, connecting the folder, pasting instructions, verifying setup).
  • Every context file the project references, plus any required custom skills.

What it leaves out

MCP connector credentials (WebSearch, Gmail, etc.), scheduled-task configs, internal pipeline files, and the standard Anthropic skills that ship with Cowork by default.

When to use it

You want to share a working copy of a Cowork project with a team member. Currently supports Help Center Advisor, Salesforce Admin Assistant, and Work Personal Assistant.

How to trigger it

"snapshot this project"

"export this cowork"

"package this for the team"

"make a shareable version"
